operations.name: font.list
operations.description: List installed fonts with postScriptName/family/style (app.fonts, AE 24.0+). Use postScriptName with text.set_style. Filter with familyContains.

params.name: familyContains
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match on family name

operations.name: font.list_missing
operations.description: List fonts that are missing or substituted in the current project (app.fonts, AE 24.0+). Pair with project.replace_font to fix.

operations.name: font.info
operations.description: Full FontObject details for a font (AE 24.0+): names, location, Adobe Fonts / substitute flags, and variable-font design axes (designAxesData/designVector). Look up by postScriptName, or by family (+ optional style).

operations.name: font.check_glyphs
operations.description: Check whether a font has glyphs for every character of a string (FontObject.hasGlyphsFor, AE 25.1+). Essential before setting CJK or symbol text on a Latin-only font.

operations.name: font.list_used
operations.description: List every font used in the project with its usage references (Project.usedFonts, AE 24.5+). The reverse of font.list_missing: answers 'which fonts does this project depend on'.

operations.name: font.list_duplicates
operations.description: List groups of installed fonts that share a PostScript name (FontsObject.fontsDuplicateByPostScriptName, AE 24.6+) — the usual cause of 'wrong font picked' surprises.

operations.name: font.get_lists
operations.description: Read the Character panel's Favorites and most-recently-used font family lists (AE 24.6+).

operations.name: font.set_favorites
operations.description: Replace the Character panel's Favorites font family list (FontsObject.favoriteFontFamilyList, AE 24.6+).

params.name: families
params.description: Font family names, in display order

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

operations.name: font.set_substitution
operations.description: Configure automatic replacement of substituted (missing) fonts (AE 24.6+): matchPolicy postScriptName|ctfiEqual|disabled, and freezeSync to stop Adobe Fonts auto-sync on project open.

params.name: freezeSync
params.description: Suppress Adobe Fonts auto-sync of substituted fonts

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

operations.name: font.get_default_for_script
operations.description: Read the default font for a writing script (FontsObject.getDefaultFontForCTScript, AE 25.1+): roman|japanese|arabic|cyrillic|greek|hebrew|thai|devanagari, or a raw CTScript member name like CT_HANGUL_SCRIPT.

operations.name: font.set_default_for_script
operations.description: Set the default font AE uses for a writing script (FontsObject.setDefaultFontForCTScript, AE 25.1+). Script names as in font.get_default_for_script; font by PostScript name.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.
